features.title: Browse and filter the revision graph
features.summary: Browse revision identity, authors, time, bookmarks, tags, workspaces, conflict/divergence markers, and filter by text, author, mine, immutability, or date.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; filter revisions to the current author.

features.title: Inspect revisions and changed files
features.summary: Open revision details, describe/full diff, browse files in flat or tree mode, and mark review status against the exact change.

configuration.constraints: One of auto, unified, or split.

failureModes: Paths containing spaces, Unicode, or shell metacharacters remain literal file identities.
Missing review or diff data is reported rather than guessed.

features.title: Preview and confirm repository mutations
features.summary: Create, squash, duplicate, revert, rebase, set bookmarks, restore, split, and abandon changes only after a single-use preview bound to exact repository state.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; show the composer change bar.
One of parent, trunk, or bookmark; invalid revset input falls back to parent.

failureModes: Changed repository state, expired preview, or unsafe fileset rejects confirmation.
A failed operation refreshes status and never implies a remote push succeeded.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv local jj mutation subprocess within the registered repository.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use temporary local repositories and injected executable failures; disable remotes and never mutate a user repository.

features.title: Create workspaces and navigate session history
features.summary: Create isolated JJ workspaces at a selected revision, launch a session only after explicit confirmation, and browse/load/fork at exact durable event boundaries.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; show the panel header toggle.

failureModes: Existing workspace, ancestor, or symlink target is rejected.
History operations preserve exact sequence boundaries and do not rewrite previous events.

externalDependencies.boundary: Local workspace creation and session event history.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use a temporary JJ repository and synthetic session event stream; no user workspace or remote.
